### LowerIntrinsicCall() {#a065baf0b078aae98e7c9703d6717e15e}

<div class="doxyMemberItem">
<div class="doxyMemberProto">
<table class="doxyMemberLabels">
<tr class="doxyMemberLabels">

<table class="doxyMemberName">

<td class="doxyMemberName">void IntrinsicLowering::LowerIntrinsicCall (<a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/callinst">CallInst</a> * CI)</td>
</tr>
</table>
</td>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Replace a call to the specified intrinsic function.</p>


<p>If an intrinsic function must be implemented by the code generator (such as va_start), this function should print a message and abort.</p>


<p>Otherwise, if an intrinsic function call can be lowered, the code to implement it (often a call to a non-intrinsic function) is inserted <em>after</em> the call instruction and the call is deleted. The caller must be capable of handling this kind of change.</p>
